# PatientFlow

> PatientFlow is patient retention and clinic management software that turns a clinic's existing patient database into predictable monthly revenue. It automates WhatsApp follow-ups, appointment reminders, treatment recalls and reactivation campaigns so clinics grow without increasing ad spend. Built by Crea8iv Media for clinics in Pakistan.

## What it does
- Reactivates inactive patients via automated WhatsApp campaigns
- Sends appointment confirmations, 24-hour and 2-hour reminders, birthday and seasonal campaigns, treatment recalls, review requests, referral and membership renewals
- Manages appointments, operational patient profiles, billing/invoices, inventory, staff roles and reporting; it is not an EHR
- Provides a branded public booking website and patient portal
- Tracks campaign ROI: messages sent, responses, appointments booked and revenue generated
- Provides an embeddable public appointment booking widget for clinic websites
- Supports white-label clinic portals, custom domains, audit logs, role-based access and backups

## Who it's for
Clinics that depend on repeat visits: dental, orthodontic, skin, aesthetic, hair transplant, medical, IVF and cosmetic practices. Single location or multi-branch.

## Pricing
- Starter — PKR 25,000/month, or PKR 150,000/year when paid in advance (50% off): appointments, operational patient profiles, billing, staff roles, booking website, daily backups. Unlimited staff and patients.
- AppointmentFlow AI — PKR 40,000/month, or PKR 336,000/year when paid in advance (30% off): everything in Starter plus WhatsApp shared inbox, automated reminders, recall/reactivation campaigns, broadcasts, an administrative AI receptionist and advanced analytics. Clinical AI advice and treatment-note generation are disabled.

## Proof
Example campaign: a 3,500-patient database received an automated WhatsApp summer whitening promotion → 150 responses → 45 booked appointments → PKR 675,000 revenue.

## Common answers
- What is PatientFlow? PatientFlow is clinic management and patient retention software for clinics that need appointments, billing, patient operations, staff roles, WhatsApp reminders, recalls and reactivation in one system.
- Who is PatientFlow for? PatientFlow is for dental, orthodontic, skin, aesthetic, hair transplant, medical, IVF and cosmetic clinics, including single-location and multi-branch clinics.
- Does PatientFlow replace an EHR? No. PatientFlow is an operational clinic portal and patient-retention system, not an authoritative clinical record system.
- What makes PatientFlow useful for clinic growth? It helps clinics bring existing patients back with WhatsApp reminders, recalls, reactivation campaigns, review requests and ROI reporting.
- Where is PatientFlow focused? PatientFlow is built by Crea8iv Media for clinics in Islamabad and across Pakistan.
